description: Source code for a firmware image creation utility, including functions for layout creation, validation, and image building, with command-line interface handling.

classes.name: fw_layout_t
classes.description: Structure defining firmware layout parameters such as kernel start address, entry point, and maximum length.

classes.name: fw_info
classes.description: Structure holding firmware information including name, layout, and signature flag.

classes.name: part_data_t
classes.description: Structure representing partition data including name, addresses, size, filename, and file stats.

classes.name: image_info_t
classes.description: Structure holding overall image information such as magic, version, output filename, parts, and firmware info.

methods.name: get_fwinfo
methods.description: Retrieve firmware info structure based on board name.

methods.name: write_header
methods.description: Write firmware header with magic and version into memory.

methods.name: write_signature
methods.description: Write signature data into memory at specified offset.

methods.name: write_signature_rsa
methods.description: Write RSA signature data into memory at specified offset.

methods.name: write_part
methods.description: Read partition file, map into memory, and write its data and metadata into the firmware image buffer.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Display usage information for the command-line utility.

methods.name: print_image_info
methods.description: Print details of the firmware image layout.

methods.name: create_image_layout
methods.description: Create firmware layout based on kernel and root filesystem files and board type.

methods.name: validate_image_layout
methods.description: Validate the firmware image layout and populate file stats.

methods.name: build_image
methods.description: Construct the firmware image in memory and write to output file.
